Load required libraries

```{r, load-libraries, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(lubridate)    # For dates
library(dplyr)        # Data manipulation
library(tidyr)        # pivot
library(ggplot2)      # Data visualization
library(data.table)   # Working with large files
library(xgboost)      # XGBoost model
library(caret)        # Preprocessing
library(caTools)
library(lightgbm)
# library(cvms)
```

```{r, load-dataset}
dataset <- fread(file.path("data", "processed", "final_dataset.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Add engineered features
dataset[, `:=`(
  # Time features
  is_rush_hour = as.numeric(hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18)),
  is_weekend = as.numeric(dow %in% c(1,7)),
  season = fcase(
    month %in% c(12,1,2), 1,
    month %in% c(3,4,5), 2,
    month %in% c(6,7,8), 3,
    month %in% c(9,10,11), 4
  ),
  
  # Weather interactions
  temp_humid = pa_temp * pa_humidity,
  wind_speed_direction = wind_speed * cos(wind_direction),
  
  # Traffic-time interactions
  rush_congestion = mean_congestion_major * (hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18)),
  
  # Fire-weather interactions
  fire_wind = ifelse(f_sz != 0, 
                     wind_speed * cos((wind_direction - f_dir) * pi/180), 
                     0),
  # Cyclical transformations for hour
  hour_sin = sin(2 * pi * hour / 24),
  hour_cos = cos(2 * pi * hour / 24),
  
  # Cyclical transformations for month
  month_sin = sin(2 * pi * month / 12),
  month_cos = cos(2 * pi * month / 12)
)]
```

```{r}
# Create two feature sets: with and without early lags
features_with_lags <- setdiff(names(dataset), 
                              c("time_stamp", "sensor_index", "pm2.5_alt"))

```


```{r}
# Sort and split data
dataset <- dataset[order(time_stamp)]
split_index <- floor(0.7 * nrow(dataset))
split_time <- dataset$time_stamp[split_index]
# Create training and test sets
train_data <- dataset[time_stamp <= split_time]
test_data <- dataset[time_stamp > split_time]
```

```{r}
# Convert to matrix format for LightGBM
train_matrix <- as.matrix(train_data[, features_with_lags, with = FALSE])
test_matrix <- as.matrix(test_data[, features_with_lags, with = FALSE])
train_labels <- train_data$`pm2.5_alt`  # Replace 'pm2.5_alt' with your target column name
test_labels <- test_data$`pm2.5_alt`    # Replace 'pm2.5_alt' with your target column name
```


```{}
# Prepare LightGBM datasets
dtrain <- lgb.Dataset(data = train_matrix, label = train_labels)
```

```{}
# Define LightGBM parameters
params <- list(
  objective = "regression",
  metric = "rmse",
  learning_rate = 0.1,
  num_leaves = 31,         # Equivalent to max_depth of ~6
  max_depth = 6,
  feature_fraction = 0.8,  # Like colsample_bytree in XGBoost
  bagging_fraction = 0.8,  # Like subsample in XGBoost
  bagging_freq = 1,        # Perform bagging every iteration
  min_data_in_leaf = 20,   # Minimum samples per leaf
  lambda_l1 = 0.0,         # L1 regularization
  lambda_l2 = 1.0          # L2 regularization
)

> # Calculate RMSE
> rmse <- sqrt(mean((predictions - test_labels)^2))
> print(paste("LightGBM RMSE:", round(rmse, 4)))
[1] "LightGBM RMSE: 4.5019"
>
> # Calculate R^2
> ss_total <- sum((test_labels - mean(test_labels))^2)
> ss_residuals <- sum((test_labels - predictions)^2)
> r_squared <- 1 - (ss_residuals / ss_total)
> print(paste("LightGBM R^2:", round(r_squared, 4)))
[1] "LightGBM R^2: 0.6304"
```

```{}
# Train LightGBM model
lgb_model <- lgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,                  # Maximum boosting iterations
  valids = list(test = dtrain),   # Validation set
  early_stopping_rounds = 50,     # Stop early if no improvement
  verbose = 0                     # Don't show progress
)
```

```{}
# Predict on the test dataset
predictions <- predict(lgb_model, test_matrix)

# Calculate RMSE
rmse <- sqrt(mean((predictions - test_labels)^2))
print(paste("LightGBM RMSE:", round(rmse, 4)))

# Calculate R^2
ss_total <- sum((test_labels - mean(test_labels))^2)
ss_residuals <- sum((test_labels - predictions)^2)
r_squared <- 1 - (ss_residuals / ss_total)
print(paste("LightGBM R^2:", round(r_squared, 4)))
```

```{r}
dtrain <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = train_matrix,
  label = train_labels,
  params = list(feature_pre_filter = FALSE)  # Add this line
)
```

```{r}
# Define parameter grid
param_grid <- expand.grid(
  learning_rate = c(0.05, 0.1),
  num_leaves = c(15, 31, 63),
  max_depth = c(4, 6, 8),
  feature_fraction = c(0.6, 0.8),
  bagging_fraction = c(0.6, 0.8),
  min_data_in_leaf = c(10, 20, 30),
  lambda_l1 = c(0, 1),
  lambda_l2 = c(0, 1)
)

# Initialize a dataframe to store results
results <- data.frame()

# Loop through parameter grid
for (i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  # Extract parameter combination
  params <- as.list(param_grid[i, ])
  params$objective <- "regression"
  params$metric <- "rmse"
  # params$feature_pre_filter <- FALSE  # Add this line
  
  # Train LightGBM model
  lgb_model <- lgb.train(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 500,                  # Maximum boosting iterations
    valids = list(test = dtrain),   # Validation set
    early_stopping_rounds = 50,     # Stop early if no improvement
    verbose = 0                     # Suppress output
  )
  
  # Make predictions
  predictions <- predict(lgb_model, test_matrix)
  
  # Calculate RMSE
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((predictions - test_labels)^2))
  
  # Save results
  results <- rbind(
    results,
    c(params, rmse = rmse)
  )
}

# Convert results to a dataframe
results <- as.data.frame(results)

# Sort results by RMSE
results <- results %>% arrange(rmse)

# View the best parameter combination
print(head(results))
```
